name: Block 2 — Lean Build
editing: Source plan: lifts/ or Council block2.md. For the next block, replace days, exercises, weeks, and deload. Keep an exercise id the same when the movement continues so suggestions still use its history. A day slot can override sets, repLow, repHigh, seconds, and extraLeftSets for a shared exercise.

equipment.note: Adjustable kettlebells, 25–40 lb in 5 lb steps, and a bench.

cues: Rest 60–90 seconds. The timer uses 90. Full rest after both sides.
Mark a light set as Warm-up. It stays on this phone and is not sent.
Stop the set when form slips.
Stop the session if you feel dizzy, faint, short of breath, or chest pain.

ladder: When every working set hits the top of the range, add 5 lb and start the next session at the bottom of that day's range.
At 40 lb, one change at a time: reps to 12, then 15, a 2-second pause, a 4-second lowering, one extra set (cap 5 bilateral, 4 per side), then 45–60 seconds rest.
Front plank stops at 45 seconds. After that, add time on the side plank.

deload.label: Week 6 deload
deload.note: Two sets of every exercise. Keep the load, or drop 5 lb. No added pause and no short rest. RIR 3.

weeks.note: RIR 2. Stop with about 2 reps left.
RIR 2. Stop with about 2 reps left.
RIR 1–2. Last build week before the deload.
Deload. RIR 3. Two sets. Keep the load or drop 5 lb.

days.name: Unilateral
days.note: Optional warm-up: 5 bodyweight split squats per side.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: One bell at the chest. Elbows inside the knees.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: Floor press is the substitute. Log the bell weight.

exercises.name: One-Arm Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: One bell. Left arm first. Neutral spine. Wednesday adds one set on the left only.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.afterCapNote: 45s is the top for the front plank. Add time on the side plank.
exercises.note: Bodyweight. 2 × 30–45 s. Add 5 s when every set hits the target. Cap 45 s.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: One bell, held in both hands. Soft knees, hips back, neutral spine.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.note: Bodyweight. 2 × 20–30 s per side. Left side first.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: Goblet hold. Rear foot stays on the floor. Left leg first.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Bench Press (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: One bell. Left arm first. Floor press is the substitute.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Kettlebell)
exercises.note: One bell. Left leg first. Hips square, soft knee on the standing leg.
